ITEM 1 | Cauliflower florets, creamy white with slightly pale yellow-cream tint, matte surface, firm bumpy clusters with small tight buds, roughly 8 cm across in a cluster group on upper-left of plate, no visible browning or sauce | 110
ITEM 2 | Cherry tomatoes, glossy bright red, smooth skin, whole and intact, six small oval fruits about 3 cm long clustered on left side of plate, juicy-looking sheen | 105
ITEM 3 | Whole raw almonds, tan-brown with slightly pitted ridged shells, matte dry surface, about 40 nuts scattered across right-center of plate forming a loose heap about 9 cm across, no oil or glaze visible | 60
ITEM 4 | Yellow squash rounds, bright golden-yellow skin with pale creamy interior flesh and visible seed cavity, two halves cut crosswise each about 6 cm diameter and 3 cm thick, smooth moist-looking cut face, sitting at bottom center of plate | 130
